confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most grounded; accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and rates vary by location. Cocktail (about 5 times the beer anchor) and wine glass (about 4.5 times the beer anchor) follow the local beer relationship because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weak. The FX observation came from RBA pages surfaced in web search results, consistent across two searches, not from a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Vietnamese central-coast beach resort pricing, benchmarked from general knowledge against Da Nang and Phan Thiet / Mui Ne for restaurant, cafe, and hotel price levels. Anchors use general knowledge only; web search was used only for the RBA FX observation.
